unit.masteryTimeline.noGap: This check found no clear difficulty.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.fundamental: This practice suggests the basics are not secure yet. Review the definitions and examples, then try a few basic questions.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.transfer: You can handle basic questions, but a new wording or mixed problem is still unstable. Practice several question types.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.trap: Similar choices or common traps caused difficulty. Review the easily confused points side by side.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.conceptual: The meaning of the concept is still easy to mix up. Explain it in your own words, then try a few checks.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.procedural: The solution steps are not stable yet. Write each step out and check the order.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.computational: The approach is mostly right, but signs or arithmetic need checking. Slow down and verify each step.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.reading: The question was not interpreted precisely. Mark the given conditions and the question before solving.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.careless: This looks like a checking slip. Before submitting, check for misreading, copying, or missing a step.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.mastered: This practice suggests the concept is mastered. Try a more flexible question type next.
unit.masteryTimeline.gap.fallback: Mastery is not clear yet. Try a few questions in different forms to confirm it.
